name: Dennis Rodman
description: Dennis Keith Rodman (born May 13, 1961) is an American former professional basketball player and Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame inductee. A five-time NBA champion, he was known for his rebounding and for changing his very short hairstyles with vivid dye and graphic designs. Contemporary reports describe cherry-red hair with a Bulls logo in 1995 and a smiley-face dye design in 1997.
